top_stories.title: Belgium wildfire prompts evacuations and EU aid
top_stories.summary: A wildfire in Belgium has burned approximately 3,000 hectares, leading to the evacuation of nearby villages. The European Union has dispatched aircraft to assist in firefighting and emergency response efforts.

top_stories.title: Ukraine launches 600 drones at Russia
top_stories.summary: Ukraine launched around 600 drones targeting Russia, described as one of the largest aerial attacks of the war. The massive drone strike represents a significant escalation in the ongoing conflict between Ukraine and Russia.

sources.headline: 🔴 Live: Ukraine launches 600 drones at Russia, one of its largest aerial attacks of the war

top_stories.title: North Korea sends troops to support Russia in Ukraine
top_stories.summary: North Korea has announced the deployment of troops to assist Russia's military operations in Ukraine. The move aims to bolster Russia's fighting capacity on the front lines amid continued warfare.

sources.headline: Troops from North Korea to boost Russia's Ukraine forces

top_stories.title: France's under-15 social media ban blocked
top_stories.summary: France's proposed restriction on social media use for under-15s has been blocked by government authorities. The decision follows extensive legal scrutiny and public debate over the measure's implications.

sources.headline: Why France's under-15 social media ban was blocked

top_stories.title: Morocco detains migrants at Ceuta border
top_stories.summary: Moroccan authorities have detained dozens of migrants attempting to cross into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta. The detentions reflect ongoing migration challenges at Europe's external borders.
